newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine May industrial output up 5.3 pct - FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine May industrial output up 5.3 pct - FIEL.

text.p: Argentina industrial production rose 5.3 percent in May compared to same month last year, the FIEL economic consultancy said in revised figures released Monday.
Output was up 2.8 percent from April this year, FIEL added.
In the first five months of the year, industrial production was up 7.4 percent compared with the same period a year earlier.
The consultancy added that its industrial production index, introduced in 1980, stood at a record level in May.
In earlier figures released last week, FIEL had industrial production up 5.2 percent from the same month in 1996.
May's figure compared with growth of 8.3 percent in April from the same month a year ago, according to FIEL.

FIEL said that during the first five months of the year, seven of the 19 industrial sectors measured in the production index rose more than the average industrial growth, five increased less than the average, two were unchanged and five declined in the period compared with the same four months in 1996.
